ceo.name: Andy Jassy
ceo.background: Harvard College (Government), Harvard Business School MBA. Joined Amazon 1997, Founded AWS 2003, CEO of AWS 2003-2021, Amazon CEO since July 2021
ceo.track_record: Built AWS from startup to $91B revenue with 27% operating margin. Successfully transitioned from Jeff Bezos as CEO. Leading AI transformation with $75B investment plan for 2025

cfo.name: Brian Olsavsky
cfo.background: Carnegie Mellon University - Tepper School of Business. Joined Amazon 2002, CFO since 2015. Previously VP Finance for Global Consumer Business and North America retail

key_executives.role: Head of AI Models & Custom Chips (new 2025)
key_executives.background: Longtime AWS executive, now leading AI model development and quantum computing
